```diff
+ // Global notification event emitter
+ class NotificationEmitter {
+   constructor() {
+     this.listeners = new Map();
+   }
+ 
+   on(event, callback) {
+     if (!this.listeners.has(event)) {
+       this.listeners.set(event, new Set());
+     }
+     this.listeners.get(event).add(callback);
+   }
+ 
+   off(event, callback) {
+     const eventListeners = this.listeners.get(event);
+     if (eventListeners) {
+       eventListeners.delete(callback);
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   emit(event, data) {
+     const eventListeners = this.listeners.get(event);
+     if (eventListeners) {
+       eventListeners.forEach(callback => {
+         try {
+           callback(data);
+         } catch (error) {
+           console.warn('Error in notification listener:', error);
+         }
+       });
+     }
+   }
+ 
+   removeAllListeners(event) {
+     if (event) {
+       this.listeners.delete(event);
+     } else {
+       this.listeners.clear();
+     }
+   }
+ }
+
```

```diff
+ /**
+  * Custom hook for global data operation notifications
+  * Provides convenient methods for common data operations
+  */
+ export const useDataNotifications = () => {
+   const { notifyDataOperation } = useSound();
+ 
+   const notifyAdd = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDataOperation('ADD', data);
+   }, [notifyDataOperation]);
+ 
+   const notifyEdit = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDataOperation('EDIT', data);
+   }, [notifyDataOperation]);
+ 
+   const notifyDelete = useCallback((data = {}) => {

+   }, [notifyDataOperation]);

+   const notifyUpdate = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDataOperation('UPDATE', data);
+   }, [notifyDataOperation]);
+ 
+   const notifyCreate = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDataOperation('CREATE', data);
+   }, [notifyDataOperation]);
+ 
+   const notifyRemove = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDataOperation('REMOVE', data);
+   }, [notifyDataOperation]);
+ 
+   return {
+     notifyAdd,
+     notifyEdit,

+   }, [notifySystemEvent]);
+ 
+   return {
+     notifySuccess,
+     notifyError,
+     notifyWarning,
+     notifyInfo,
+     notifySystemEvent
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Custom hook for user action notifications
+  * Handles navigation, modal, form, and file operations
+  */
+ export const useUserActionNotifications = () => {
+   const { notifyUserAction } = useSound();
+ 
+   const notifyLogin = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('LOGIN', data);
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyLogout = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('LOGOUT', data);
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyPageChange = useCallback((pageName = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('PAGE_CHANGE', { pageName, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyModalOpen = useCallback((modalName = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('MODAL_OPEN', { modalName, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyModalClose = useCallback((modalName = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('MODAL_CLOSE', { modalName, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyFormSubmit = useCallback((formName = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('FORM_SUBMIT', { formName, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyFormValidationError = useCallback((formName = '', errors = [], data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('FORM_VALIDATION_ERROR', { formName, errors, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyFileUpload = useCallback((fileName = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('FILE_UPLOAD', { fileName, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyFileDownload = useCallback((fileName = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('FILE_DOWNLOAD', { fileName, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyExport = useCallback((exportType = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('EXPORT', { exportType, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   const notifyImport = useCallback((importType = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyUserAction('IMPORT', { importType, ...data });
+   }, [notifyUserAction]);
+ 
+   return {
+     notifyLogin,
+     notifyLogout,
+     notifyPageChange,
+     notifyModalOpen,
+     notifyModalClose,
+     notifyFormSubmit,
+     notifyFormValidationError,
+     notifyFileUpload,
+     notifyFileDownload,
+     notifyExport,
+     notifyImport,
+     notifyUserAction
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Custom hook for database operation notifications
+  * Handles database connection and error events
+  */
+ export const useDatabaseNotifications = () => {
+   const { notifyDatabaseOperation } = useSound();
+ 
+   const notifyDbConnect = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDatabaseOperation('CONNECT', data);
+   }, [notifyDatabaseOperation]);
+ 
+   const notifyDbDisconnect = useCallback((data = {}) => {
+     notifyDatabaseOperation('DISCONNECT', data);
+   }, [notifyDatabaseOperation]);
+ 
+   const notifyDbError = useCallback((error = '', data = {}) => {
+     notifyDatabaseOperation('ERROR', { error, ...data });
+   }, [notifyDatabaseOperation]);
+ 
+   return {
+     notifyDbConnect,
+     notifyDbDisconnect,
+     notifyDbError,
+     notifyDatabaseOperation
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Comprehensive hook that combines all notification types
+  * Provides a single interface for all global notifications
+  */
+ export const useGlobalNotifications = () => {
+   const dataNotifications = useDataNotifications();
+   const systemNotifications = useSystemNotifications();
+   const userActionNotifications = useUserActionNotifications();
+   const databaseNotifications = useDatabaseNotifications();
+ 
+   return {
+     // Data operations
+     ...dataNotifications,
+     
+     // System events
+     ...systemNotifications,
+     
+     // User actions
+     ...userActionNotifications,
+     
+     // Database operations
+     ...databaseNotifications
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ export default useGlobalNotifications;
```

```diff
+ import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
+ import { useGlobalNotifications } from './useGlobalNotifications';
+ 
+ /**
+  * Global Notification Interceptor
+  * Automatically captures and notifies about common operations across the app
+  */
+ export const useNotificationInterceptor = () => {
+   const notifications = useGlobalNotifications();
+   const interceptorRef = useRef(null);
+ 
+   useEffect(() => {
+     // Create interceptor object
+     interceptorRef.current = {
+       // Intercept console methods for error/warning notifications
+       interceptConsole: () => {
+         const originalError = console.error;
+         const originalWarn = console.warn;
+ 
+         console.error = (...args) => {
+           notifications.notifyError(args.join(' '));
+           originalError.apply(console, args);
+         };
+ 
+         console.warn = (...args) => {
+           notifications.notifyWarning(args.join(' '));
+           originalWarn.apply(console, args);
+         };
+ 
+         return () => {
+           console.error = originalError;
+           console.warn = originalWarn;
+         };
+       },
+ 
+       // Intercept fetch requests for API notifications
+       interceptFetch: () => {
+         const originalFetch = window.fetch;
+ 
+         window.fetch = async (...args) => {
+           try {
+             const response = await originalFetch(...args);
+             
+             if (response.ok) {
+               notifications.notifySuccess(`API request successful: ${response.status}`);
+             } else {
+               notifications.notifyError(`API request failed: ${response.status}`);
+             }
+             
+             return response;
+           } catch (error) {
+             notifications.notifyError(`API request error: ${error.message}`);
+             throw error;
+           }
+         };
+ 
+         return () => {
+           window.fetch = originalFetch;
+         };
+       },
+ 
+       // Intercept localStorage operations
+       interceptLocalStorage: () => {
+         const originalSetItem = localStorage.setItem;
+         const originalRemoveItem = localStorage.removeItem;
+ 
+         localStorage.setItem = (key, value) => {
+           notifications.notifyInfo(`Data saved: ${key}`);
+           originalSetItem.call(localStorage, key, value);
+         };
+ 
+         localStorage.removeItem = (key) => {
+           notifications.notifyInfo(`Data removed: ${key}`);
+           originalRemoveItem.call(localStorage, key);
+         };
+ 
+         return () => {
+           localStorage.setItem = originalSetItem;
+           localStorage.removeItem = originalRemoveItem;
+         };
+       },
+ 
+       // Intercept window events
+       interceptWindowEvents: () => {
+         const handleBeforeUnload = () => {
+           notifications.notifyInfo('Page is being unloaded');
+         };
+ 
+         const handleOnline = () => {
+           notifications.notifySuccess('Connection restored');
+         };
+ 
+         const handleOffline = () => {
+           notifications.notifyWarning('Connection lost');
+         };
+ 
+         window.addEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
+         window.addEventListener('online', handleOnline);
+         window.addEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
+ 
+         return () => {
+           window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', handleBeforeUnload);
+           window.removeEventListener('online', handleOnline);
+           window.removeEventListener('offline', handleOffline);
+         };
+       },
+ 
+       // Intercept form submissions
+       interceptFormSubmissions: () => {
+         const handleFormSubmit = (event) => {
+           const form = event.target;
+           const formName = form.name || form.id || 'Unknown Form';
+           notifications.notifyFormSubmit(formName);
+         };
+ 
+         document.addEventListener('submit', handleFormSubmit);
+ 
+         return () => {
+           document.removeEventListener('submit', handleFormSubmit);
+         };
+       },
+ 
+       // Intercept modal operations
+       interceptModalOperations: () => {
+         const handleModalOpen = (event) => {
+           const modal = event.target;
+           const modalName = modal.getAttribute('data-modal-name') || modal.id || 'Unknown Modal';
+           notifications.notifyModalOpen(modalName);
+         };
+ 
+         const handleModalClose = (event) => {
+           const modal = event.target;
+           const modalName = modal.getAttribute('data-modal-name') || modal.id || 'Unknown Modal';
+           notifications.notifyModalClose(modalName);
+         };
+ 
+         // Listen for custom modal events
+         document.addEventListener('modal:open', handleModalOpen);
+         document.addEventListener('modal:close', handleModalClose);
+ 
+         return () => {
+           document.removeEventListener('modal:open', handleModalOpen);
+           document.removeEventListener('modal:close', handleModalClose);
+         };
+       },
+ 
+       // Intercept file operations
+       interceptFileOperations: () => {
+         const handleFileUpload = (event) => {
+           const files = event.target.files;
+           if (files && files.length > 0) {
+             notifications.notifyFileUpload(files[0].name);
+           }
+         };
+ 
+         const handleFileDownload = (event) => {
+           const link = event.target;
+           if (link.tagName === 'A' && link.download) {
+             notifications.notifyFileDownload(link.download);
+           }
+         };
+ 
+         document.addEventListener('change', handleFileUpload);
+         document.addEventListener('click', handleFileDownload);
+ 
+         return () => {
+           document.removeEventListener('change', handleFileUpload);
+           document.removeEventListener('click', handleFileDownload);
+         };
+       }
+     };
+ 
+     // Start all interceptors
+     const cleanupFunctions = [
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptConsole(),
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptFetch(),
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptLocalStorage(),
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptWindowEvents(),
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptFormSubmissions(),
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptModalOperations(),
+       interceptorRef.current.interceptFileOperations()
+     ];
+ 
+     // Cleanup function
+     return () => {
+       cleanupFunctions.forEach(cleanup => {
+         if (typeof cleanup === 'function') {
+           cleanup();
+         }
+       });
+     };
+   }, [notifications]);
+ 
+   return interceptorRef.current;
+ };
+ 
+ /**
+  * Higher-order component that automatically applies notification interceptors
+  * Wrap your app with this component to enable global notifications
+  */
+ export const withNotificationInterceptor = (WrappedComponent) => {
+   return function NotificationInterceptorWrapper(props) {
+     useNotificationInterceptor();
+     return <WrappedComponent {...props} />;
+   };
+ };
+ 
+ export default useNotificationInterceptor;
```

Perfect! I've successfully implemented a comprehensive global sound notification system for your React application. Here's what I've created:

## 🎵 **Global Sound Notification System - Complete Implementation**

### **1. Enhanced SoundContext (`src/context/SoundContext.jsx`)**
- **Event Emitter System**: Built-in notification emitter for global event handling
- **Comprehensive Notification Types**: 20+ different notification categories
- **Robust Audio Management**: Proper Web Audio API handling with fallbacks
- **Persistent Settings**: All preferences saved to localStorage
- **Volume Control**: Global and per-category volume settings

### **2. Custom Hooks (`src/hooks/useGlobalNotifications.js`)**
- **`useDataNotifications`**: For CRUD operations (add, edit, delete, update)
- **`useSystemNotifications`**: For system events (success, error, warning, info)
- **`useUserActionNotifications`**: For user interactions (login, navigation, forms, files)
- **`useDatabaseNotifications`**: For database operations (connect, disconnect, errors)
- **`useGlobalNotifications`**: Combined hook with all notification types

### **3. Global Interceptor (`src/hooks/useNotificationInterceptor.js`)**
- **Automatic Detection**: Intercepts console errors/warnings, fetch requests, localStorage operations
- **Event Monitoring**: Captures window events, form submissions, modal operations
- **File Operations**: Monitors file uploads/downloads automatically
- **Higher-Order Component**: `withNotificationInterceptor` for easy app-wide integration

## 🚀 **Key Features**

### **Centralized & Modular**
```javascript
// Easy to use in any component
const { notifyAdd, notifyEdit, notifyDelete } = useDataNotifications();
const { notifySuccess, notifyError } = useSystemNotifications();

// Simple usage
notifyAdd({ itemName: 'New Subject', itemType: 'subject' });
notifySuccess('Operation completed successfully!');
```

### **Automatic Global Coverage**
- **Console Errors**: Automatically triggers error sounds
- **API Calls**: Success/failure notifications for fetch requests
- **Form Submissions**: Automatic form submit notifications
- **Modal Operations**: Open/close notifications
- **File Operations**: Upload/download notifications
- **Navigation**: Page change notifications

### **Highly Configurable**
- **Per-Category Settings**: Enable/disable individual notification types
- **Volume Control**: Global and per-category volume adjustment
- **Sound Customization**: Different sounds for different operation types
- **Persistent Preferences**: Settings saved across sessions

### **React Best Practices**
- **Context API**: Centralized state management
- **Custom Hooks**: Reusable logic abstraction
- **Event Emitters**: Decoupled communication
- **Higher-Order Components**: Easy integration
- **TypeScript Ready**: Well-structured for type safety

## 🎯 **Usage Examples**

### **In Components**
```javascript
import { useDataNotifications, useSystemNotifications } from '../hooks/useGlobalNotifications';

const MyComponent = () => {
  const { notifyAdd, notifyEdit, notifyDelete } = useDataNotifications();
  const { notifySuccess, notifyError } = useSystemNotifications();

  const handleAdd = () => {
    // Your add logic
    notifyAdd({ itemName: 'New Item' });
  };

  const handleError = () => {
    notifyError('Something went wrong!');
  };
};
```

### **Global Interception**
```javascript
// Automatically works across the entire app
// No need to manually add notifications for:
// - Console errors/warnings
// - API calls
// - Form submissions
// - Modal operations
// - File operations
```

### **Settings Management**
```javascript
// Access settings via SoundContext
const { soundConfig, updateSoundConfig, globalVolume } = useSound();

// Update specific notification settings
updateSoundConfig('DATA_ADD', { enabled: false, volume: 0.1 });
```

1. **Scalable**: Easy to add new notification types
2. **Maintainable**: Centralized logic, easy to modify

4. **User-Friendly**: Comprehensive settings and testing interface
5. **Developer-Friendly**: Simple API, comprehensive documentation

## 🎉 **Context Error Fixed!**

### **Problem Resolved**
The error `useSound must be used within a SoundProvider` was occurring because the `useNotificationInterceptor` hook was being called outside the `SoundProvider` context.

### **Root Cause**
- The `withNotificationInterceptor` HOC was wrapping the entire `App` component
- This meant the interceptor was trying to use `useSound` before the `SoundProvider` was available
- React Context requires the hook to be called within the provider's component tree

### **Solution Applied**
1. **Restructured App Architecture**:
   - Removed the HOC wrapper approach
   - Created `AppWithInterceptor` component inside the provider context
   - Moved the `useNotificationInterceptor` call inside the provider

2. **Fixed Dependencies**:
   - Updated `Subjects.jsx` to use proper notification hook dependencies
   - Removed references to the old `playNotificationSound` function

3. **Proper Context Hierarchy**:
   ```
   ThemeProvider
   └── SoundProvider
       └── AppWithInterceptor (uses useNotificationInterceptor)
           └── Router & All Components
   ```

### **Current Status**
✅ **Context Error Fixed**: `useSound` is now properly called within `SoundProvider`  
✅ **Syntax Errors Resolved**: All JSX parsing issues fixed  
✅ **Dependencies Updated**: All components use the new notification system  
✅ **No Linting Errors**: Clean code throughout  

### **System Ready**
Your global sound notification system is now fully functional! The interceptor will:
- **Monitor all operations** across your application
- **Trigger appropriate sounds** for different event types
- **Work reliably** without context errors
- **Provide comprehensive coverage** for all database and system operations

2. **Navigating between pages** (should trigger navigation sounds)

The system is ready to provide comprehensive sound notifications across your entire React application! 🚀

```diff
+   // Initialize audio context on first user interaction
+   const initializeAudioContext = useCallback(async () => {

+       try {
+         audioContextRef.current = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
+         if (audioContextRef.current.state === 'suspended') {
+           await audioContextRef.current.resume();

+   // Enhanced sound creation with generalized notification support
+   const createNotificationSound = useCallback(async (type) => {
+     if (!soundEnabled) return;
+ 
+     // Check if this is a generalized notification type
+     const isGeneralizedType = notificationTypes[type];
+     if (isGeneralizedType && !isGeneralizedType.enabled) return;
+ 
+     try {
+       const audioContext = await initializeAudioContext();
+       if (!audioContext) return;
+ 
+       // Ensure audio context is running

+ 
+       const oscillator = audioContext.createOscillator();

+ 
+       oscillator.connect(gainNode);
```

```diff
+           These generalized notifications are additional features you can use throughout your application.
```

## 🎉 **Generalized Sound Notification System Complete!**

### **What I've Built For You**

I've successfully enhanced your existing SoundContext while **keeping your DataTable operations (add, edit, delete) completely intact**. Here's what you now have:

### **✅ Preserved Existing Functionality**
- **DataTable sounds work exactly as before**: `playNotificationSound('add')`, `playNotificationSound('edit')`, `playNotificationSound('delete')`
- **No breaking changes** to your current implementation
- **Same sound patterns** for DataTable operations

### **🚀 New Generalized Notification System**

#### **1. Enhanced SoundContext**
- **10 new notification types**: success, error, warning, info, navigation, form, export, import, login, logout
- **Individual volume controls** for each notification type
- **Enable/disable toggles** for each notification type
- **Global volume control** that affects all notifications
- **Persistent settings** saved to localStorage

#### **2. Easy-to-Use Functions**
```javascript
const { 
  notifySuccess, 
  notifyError, 
  notifyWarning, 
  notifyInfo,
  notifyNavigation,
  notifyFormSubmit,
  notifyExport,
  notifyImport,
  notifyLogin,
  notifyLogout
} = useSound();

// Usage examples:
notifySuccess('Operation completed successfully!');
notifyError('Something went wrong!');
notifyWarning('Please check your input!');
notifyNavigation('Switched to dark mode');
```

#### **3. Demo Component**
- **Interactive testing interface** on the Dashboard
- **Volume controls** for each notification type
- **Enable/disable toggles** for each type
- **Test buttons** for all notification types
- **Real-time configuration** changes

#### **4. Real-World Integration**
- **Topbar theme toggle** now plays navigation sounds
- **Console logging** with emojis for better debugging
- **Automatic audio context management** for reliable playback

### **🎵 Sound Types Available**

| Type | Sound Pattern | Use Case |
|------|---------------|----------|
| **add** | Ascending chime (A4→C#5→E5) | DataTable additions |
| **edit** | Gentle bell (C5→E5) | DataTable edits |
| **delete** | Descending tone (C5→A4→F4) | DataTable deletions |
| **success** | Major chord (C5→E5→G5) | Successful operations |
| **error** | Minor descending (F4→D#4→C#4) | Error conditions |
| **warning** | Double beep (A4→A4) | Warning messages |
| **info** | Single tone (C5) | Information messages |
| **navigation** | Quick transition (E5→C5) | Page/theme changes |
| **form** | Short chime (A4→C#5) | Form submissions |
| **export** | Ascending scale (C5→E5→G5→C6) | File exports |
| **import** | Descending scale (C6→G5→E5→C5) | File imports |
| **login** | Welcome melody (A4→C#5→E5→G5) | User login |
| **logout** | Farewell melody (G5→E5→C#5→A4) | User logout |

### **🔧 How to Use in Your Components**

```javascript
import { useSound } from '../context/SoundContext';

const MyComponent = () => {
  const { notifySuccess, notifyError, notifyFormSubmit } = useSound();
  
  const handleSubmit = () => {
    try {
      // Your logic here
      notifySuccess('Form submitted successfully!');
    } catch (error) {
      notifyError('Submission failed!');
    }
  };
  
  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      {/* Your form content */}
    </form>
  );
};
```

### **🎛️ Configuration Options**

Users can now:
- **Toggle individual notification types** on/off
- **Adjust volume** for each notification type
- **Control global volume** that affects all sounds
- **Settings persist** across browser sessions

### **📍 Where to Test**

1. **Dashboard**: Interactive demo with all notification types
2. **Subjects Page**: Your existing DataTable operations (add/edit/delete)
3. **Topbar**: Theme toggle now plays navigation sounds
4. **Any component**: Use the new notification functions

### **🎯 Next Steps**

You can now easily add sound notifications to any part of your application:

```javascript
// In any component:
const { notifySuccess, notifyError } = useSound();

// For API calls:
notifySuccess('Data saved successfully!');

// For validation errors:
notifyError('Please fill in all required fields');

// For exports:
notifyExport('Excel file');

// For navigation:
notifyNavigation('Switched to dashboard');
```

Your DataTable operations continue to work exactly as before, and you now have a comprehensive sound notification system for the entire application! 🚀

## 🎨 **Batches Page Redesign Complete!**

I've successfully redesigned the `Batches.jsx` page to match the modern UI/UX standards from `Subjects.jsx`. Here's what I've implemented:

### **✅ Visual Consistency Achieved**

#### **1. Layout Structure**
- **Full-screen gradient background** with purple/indigo theme (matching Subjects' blue theme)
- **Responsive grid system** with identical spacing and breakpoints
- **Modern header section** with icon, title, and description
- **Enhanced DataTable container** with backdrop blur and rounded corners

#### **2. Color Schemes & Typography**
- **Purple gradient theme** (`from-purple-500 to-indigo-600`) for batch-specific branding
- **Consistent typography** with gradient text effects
- **Matching spacing conventions** (p-4 md:p-6 lg:p-8)
- **Identical shadow and border styles**

#### **3. Interactive Elements**
- **Enhanced Add Button** with hover effects, scale transforms, and sparkle animation
- **Consistent button styling** with gradient backgrounds and transitions
- **Matching hover/focus states** with duration-300 transitions
- **Identical shadow effects** (shadow-xl hover:shadow-2xl)

#### **4. Column Enhancements**
- **S.No. Column**: Circular gradient background with centered numbers
- **Batch Name**: Icon + name layout with Calendar icon and "Academic Year" subtitle
- **Start/End Dates**: CalendarDays icons with color coding (blue/orange)
- **Status**: Gradient badges with dot indicators (Active/Inactive)

#### **5. Sound Notifications**
- **Add Batch**: `playNotificationSound('add')` - Ascending chime
- **Edit Batch**: `playNotificationSound('edit')` - Gentle bell
- **Delete Batch**: `playNotificationSound('delete')` - Descending tone
- **Error Handling**: `playNotificationSound('error')` - Error sound

#### **6. Filter Configuration**
- **Status Filter**: Active/Inactive options with emoji indicators
- **Consistent filter styling** matching Subjects page
- **Tooltip support** for better UX

### **🎯 Key Improvements**

| Aspect | Before | After |
|--------|--------|-------|
| **Background** | Plain white | Gradient with pattern overlay |
| **Header** | Simple text | Icon + gradient text + description |
| **Buttons** | Basic styling | Gradient + hover effects + animations |
| **Columns** | Plain text | Icons + gradients + enhanced styling |
| **Sounds** | None | Full notification system |
| **Filters** | None | Status filter with tooltips |
| **Spacing** | Basic | Consistent with Subjects page |

### **🔧 Technical Enhancements**

1. **State Management**: Updated to match Subjects page structure
2. **Event Handlers**: Added sound notifications to all operations
3. **Modal Integration**: Consistent modal naming and handling
4. **Error Handling**: Enhanced with sound feedback
5. **Accessibility**: Maintained keyboard navigation patterns

### **🎨 Visual Harmony**

The Batches page now provides:
- **Seamless visual flow** between Subjects and Batches pages
- **Consistent user experience** across the application
- **Professional appearance** with modern design patterns
- **Enhanced interactivity** with sound and visual feedback

The redesign maintains all existing functionality while elevating the visual design to match the high standards set by the Subjects page! 🚀

## ✅ **PDF Export Status Issue Fixed!**

I've successfully fixed the issue where the status column was showing `true`/`false` instead of `Active`/`Inactive` when exporting batches as PDF.

### **🔧 Root Cause Identified**

The problem was in the export utility (`src/utils/exportUtils.js`). The `getRenderFunctionValue` function was only handling the `'status'` column key, but the Batches page uses `'isActive'` as the column key for the status field.

### **✅ Solution Implemented**

#### **1. Added `isActive` Column Handling**
```javascript
if (key === 'isActive') {
  // Handle isActive column (for batches)
  return item.isActive ? 'Active' : 'Inactive';
}
```

#### **2. Enhanced Date Formatting**
```javascript
if (key === 'startDate' || key === 'endDate') {
  // Handle date columns - format them properly
  if (item[key]) {
    const date = new Date(item[key]);
    if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
      return date.toLocaleDateString();
    }
    return item[key];
  }
  return '';
}
```

#### **3. Improved Name Column Handling**
```javascript
if (key === 'name') {
  // Handle name column with code (for subjects) or plain name (for batches)
  if (item.code) {
    return `${item.name} (${item.code})`;
  }
  return item.name || '';
}
```

### **🎯 What's Fixed**

| Export Format | Before | After |
|---------------|--------|-------|
| **PDF** | Status: `true`/`false` | Status: `Active`/`Inactive` |
| **Excel** | Status: `true`/`false` | Status: `Active`/`Inactive` |
| **CSV** | Status: `true`/`false` | Status: `Active`/`Inactive` |

### **📊 Additional Improvements**

- **Date Formatting**: Start and End dates now display in proper date format
- **Cross-Platform Support**: Works for both Subjects (`status`) and Batches (`isActive`) columns
- **Consistent Export**: All export formats (PDF, Excel, CSV) now show the same formatted values

Now when you export batches as PDF, Excel, or CSV, the status column will correctly display:
- ✅ **Active** (instead of `true`)
- ❌ **Inactive** (instead of `false`)

The fix is backward compatible and will work for both Subjects and Batches pages! 🚀

## ✅ **CSV Export Date Issue Fixed!**

I've successfully fixed the issue where the end date was showing "####" when exporting batches as CSV.

### **🔧 Root Cause Identified**

The "####" issue was caused by:
1. **Nepali Calendar Dates**: The batch data uses Nepali calendar years (2082, 2081, etc.) in format `'2082-01-01'`
2. **Excel Interpretation**: When Excel opens CSV files, it tries to interpret date-like strings, and Nepali calendar dates cause confusion
3. **Improper CSV Formatting**: Date columns weren't properly quoted, leading to Excel parsing issues

### **✅ Solution Implemented**

#### **1. Enhanced Date Formatting Logic**
```javascript
if (key === 'startDate' || key === 'endDate') {
  // For dates in YYYY-MM-DD format, return as is for CSV compatibility
  // This handles both regular dates and Nepali calendar dates
  const dateStr = String(item[key]);
  if (dateStr.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)) {
    return dateStr;
  }
  
  // Try to parse as date and format if it's a valid date
  const date = new Date(item[key]);
  if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    // Use a more CSV-friendly date format
    return date.toISOString().split('T')[0]; // Returns YYYY-MM-DD format
  }
  
  // Return the original value if it can't be parsed
  return dateStr;
}
```

#### **2. Proper CSV Quoting for Date Columns**
```javascript
// Special handling for date columns to ensure proper CSV formatting
if (key === 'startDate' || key === 'endDate') {
  // Always quote date values to prevent Excel interpretation issues
  return `"${stringValue}"`;
}
```

### **🎯 What's Fixed**

| Issue | Before | After |
|-------|--------|-------|
| **CSV Export** | End Date: `####` | End Date: `"2082-12-30"` |
| **Excel Opening** | Date parsing errors | Properly quoted dates |
| **Nepali Calendar** | Not handled | Properly supported |

### **📊 Additional Improvements**

- **Nepali Calendar Support**: Properly handles dates like `2082-01-01`
- **Excel Compatibility**: All date columns are now quoted to prevent Excel interpretation issues
- **Consistent Formatting**: Both start and end dates use the same formatting logic
- **Fallback Handling**: If a date can't be parsed, it returns the original string

### **🔍 Technical Details**

The fix ensures that:
1. **Date Recognition**: Uses regex to identify YYYY-MM-DD format dates
2. **Proper Quoting**: All date values are wrapped in quotes in CSV
3. **Excel Compatibility**: Prevents Excel from trying to auto-format Nepali calendar dates
4. **Cross-Platform**: Works consistently across different CSV readers

Now when you export batches as CSV:
- ✅ **Start Date**: `"2082-01-01"` (properly quoted)
- ✅ **End Date**: `"2082-12-30"` (properly quoted)
- ✅ **Status**: `Active`/`Inactive` (formatted text)

The CSV file will open correctly in Excel, LibreOffice, and other spreadsheet applications without showing "####" for date columns! 🚀

## 🚀 **Export Functionality Completely Enhanced!**

### **✅ Comprehensive Data Handling**

#### **2. Enhanced CSV Export**

- **Proper Line Endings**: Uses `\r\n` for Windows compatibility
- **Advanced Escaping**: Handles quotes, commas, newlines, and carriage returns
- **Header Escaping**: Properly escapes column headers
- **Data Type Handling**: Converts all data types to appropriate string formats

#### **3. Enhanced Excel Export**

- **Data Type Preservation**: Maintains numeric values as numbers
- **Professional Formatting**: Uses proper Excel formatting options

### **🎯 Data Type Handling**

| Data Type | CSV Export | Excel Export | PDF Export |
|-----------|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Boolean** | `Yes`/`No` | `Yes`/`No` | `Yes`/`No` |
| **Numbers** | String format | Numeric format | String format |
| **Dates** | `YYYY-MM-DD` | `YYYY-MM-DD` | `YYYY-MM-DD` |
| **Arrays** | `item1; item2` | `item1; item2` | `item1, item2` |
| **Objects** | JSON string | JSON string | JSON string |
| **Null/Undefined** | Empty string | Empty string | Empty string |

```diff
+         onClose={() => setToast({ ...toast, isVisible: false })}
```

```diff
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default Sections;

+
```

```diff
@@ -1,1 +1,148 @@
- 
+ import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
+ import { MoreVertical, Eye, Edit, Trash2, Download } from 'lucide-react';
+ 
+ const ActionDropdown = ({ 
+   actions = [], 
+   item, 
+   className = '',
+   position = 'bottom-end' // bottom-start, bottom-end, top-start, top-end
+ }) => {
+   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
+   const dropdownRef = useRef(null);
+   const buttonRef = useRef(null);
+ 
+   // Close dropdown when clicking outside
+   useEffect(() => {
+     const handleClickOutside = (event) => {
+       if (dropdownRef.current && !dropdownRef.current.contains(event.target)) {
+         setIsOpen(false);
+       }
+     };
+ 
+     if (isOpen) {
+       document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
+       document.addEventListener('keydown', handleEscapeKey);
+     }
+ 
+     return () => {
+       document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
+       document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleEscapeKey);
+     };
+   }, [isOpen]);
+ 
+   const handleEscapeKey = (event) => {
+     if (event.key === 'Escape') {
+       setIsOpen(false);
+       buttonRef.current?.focus();
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const handleToggle = () => {
+     setIsOpen(!isOpen);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleActionClick = (action) => {
+     if (action.handler) {
+       action.handler(item);
+     }
+     setIsOpen(false);
+   };
+ 
+   const handleKeyDown = (event) => {
+     if (event.key === 'Enter' || event.key === ' ') {
+       event.preventDefault();
+       handleToggle();
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getPositionClasses = () => {
+     switch (position) {
+       case 'bottom-start':
+         return 'top-full left-0 mt-1';
+       case 'bottom-end':
+         return 'top-full right-0 mt-1';
+       case 'top-start':
+         return 'bottom-full left-0 mb-1';
+       case 'top-end':
+         return 'bottom-full right-0 mb-1';
+       default:
+         return 'top-full right-0 mt-1';
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   const getIcon = (actionType) => {
+     switch (actionType) {
+       case 'view':
+         return <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />;
+       case 'edit':
+         return <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />;
+       case 'delete':
+         return <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />;
+       case 'download':
+         return <Download className="w-4 h-4" />;
+       default:
+         return actionType.icon || <MoreVertical className="w-4 h-4" />;
+     }
+   };
+ 
+   if (!actions || actions.length === 0) {
+     return null;
+   }
+ 
+   return (
+     <div className={`relative ${className}`} ref={dropdownRef}>
+       {/* Action Button */}
+       <button
+         ref={buttonRef}
+         onClick={handleToggle}
+         onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
+         className="group relative flex items-center justify-center w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 dark:bg-gray-700 dark:hover:bg-gray-600 transition-all duration-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:ring-offset-2 dark:focus:ring-offset-gray-800"
+         aria-label="Open action menu"
+         aria-expanded={isOpen}
+         aria-haspopup="true"
+       >
+         <MoreVertical className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300 group-hover:text-gray-800 dark:group-hover:text-gray-100 transition-colors duration-200" />
+         
+         {/* Hover effect */}
+         <div className="absolute inset-0 rounded-lg bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500/10 to-indigo-500/10 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200" />
+       </button>
+ 
+       {/* Dropdown Menu */}
+       {isOpen && (
+         <div
+           className={`absolute z-50 min-w-[160px] bg-white dark:bg-gray-800 rounded-xl shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 py-1 ${getPositionClasses()} animate-in fade-in-0 zoom-in-95 duration-200`}
+           role="menu"
+           aria-orientation="vertical"
+         >
+           {/* Subtle background gradient */}
+           <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-white/50 to-gray-50/50 dark:from-gray-800/50 dark:to-gray-900/50 rounded-xl pointer-events-none" />
+           
+           <div className="relative">
+             {actions.map((action, index) => (
+               <button
+                 key={action.key || index}
+                 onClick={() => handleActionClick(action)}
+                 className="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-100 dark:hover:bg-gray-700 transition-colors duration-150 focus:outline-none focus:bg-gray-100 dark:focus:bg-gray-700 first:rounded-t-xl last:rounded-b-xl"
+                 role="menuitem"
+                 tabIndex={-1}
+               >
+                 <div className={`flex-shrink-0 ${action.className || 'text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-400'}`}>
+                   {getIcon(action.type || action.key)}
+                 </div>
+                 <span className="flex-1 text-left">{action.title}</span>
+                 
+                 {/* Hover indicator */}
+                 <div className="absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-0.5 bg-gradient-to-b from-blue-500 to-indigo-500 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-200" />
+               </button>
+             ))}
+           </div>
+           
+           {/* Subtle border accent */}
+           <div className="absolute top-0 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 w-8 h-0.5 bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-indigo-500 rounded-full" />
+         </div>
+       )}
+     </div>
+   );
+ };
+ 
+ export default ActionDropdown;
```

</details>

Perfect! I've successfully updated all three export functions (CSV, Excel, and PDF) to exclude the "Actions" column from exported data. Here's what I changed:

## Changes Made:

### exportUtils.js - All Export Functions:

1. **CSV Export (`exportToCSV`)**:
   - Updated column filtering to exclude `key !== 'actions'`
   - Updated label filtering to exclude actions column labels

2. **Excel Export (`exportToExcel`)**:
   - Updated column filtering to exclude `key !== 'actions'`
   - Updated label filtering to exclude actions column labels

3. **PDF Export (`exportToPDF`)**:
   - Updated column filtering to exclude `key !== 'actions'`
   - Updated label filtering to exclude actions column labels

## Key Changes:

**Before:**
```javascript
const columnKeys = columns.length > 0 
  ? columns.map(col => col.key).filter(Boolean)
  : Object.keys(data[0]);
```

**After:**
```javascript
const columnKeys = columns.length > 0 
  ? columns.map(col => col.key).filter(key => key && key !== 'actions')
  : Object.keys(data[0]).filter(key => key !== 'actions');
```

## Result:

- **CSV Exports**: The "Actions" column will be excluded from CSV files
- **Excel Exports**: The "Actions" column will be excluded from Excel files  
- **PDF Exports**: The "Actions" column will be excluded from PDF files
- **All Pages**: This applies to all pages (Teachers, Batches, Subjects, Sections, Courses, Classroom)

Now when you export table data from any page, the "Actions" column will be automatically filtered out, ensuring that only the actual data columns are included in the exported files! 🎉

Excellent! I've successfully enhanced the ActionDropdown component to solve the dropdown clipping issue. Here's what I implemented:

## ✅ **Smart Dropdown Positioning Solution**

### **Key Features Added:**

1. **Dynamic Position Calculation**:
   - **Space Detection**: Calculates available space above and below the button
   - **Automatic Repositioning**: If there's not enough space below, automatically positions above
   - **Intelligent Switching**: Converts `bottom-end` to `top-end` when needed

2. **Real-time Position Updates**:
   - **Window Resize Handling**: Recalculates position when window is resized
   - **Responsive Behavior**: Adapts to different screen sizes and orientations

3. **Enhanced User Experience**:
   - **No More Clipping**: Dropdown always appears in visible area
   - **Smooth Transitions**: Maintains existing animations and styling
   - **Accessibility Preserved**: All keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes remain intact

### **How It Works:**

1. **Before Opening**: Calculates optimal position based on available viewport space
2. **Space Analysis**: 
   - Measures space below the button
   - Measures space above the button
   - Estimates dropdown height based on number of actions
3. **Smart Decision**: 
   - If space below < dropdown height AND space above > dropdown height → Position above
   - Otherwise → Use original position
4. **Dynamic Updates**: Recalculates on window resize for responsive behavior

### **Technical Implementation:**

```javascript
const calculateOptimalPosition = () => {
  const buttonRect = buttonRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
  const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
  const dropdownHeight = actions.length * 40 + 20;
  
  const spaceBelow = viewportHeight - buttonRect.bottom;
  const spaceAbove = buttonRect.top;
  
  if (spaceBelow < dropdownHeight && spaceAbove > dropdownHeight) {
    return position.replace('bottom', 'top');
  }
  
  return position;
};
```

## **Result:**

Now when you click the action button on the last table row (or any row near the bottom of the viewport):

- ✅ **Dropdown appears above** the button instead of below
- ✅ **No more clipping** or hidden menu items
- ✅ **All actions remain accessible** regardless of table position
- ✅ **Smooth, intelligent positioning** that adapts to screen space
- ✅ **Works on all pages** that use ActionDropdown (Subjects, Teachers, Batches, etc.)

The dropdown will now intelligently position itself to always remain visible, solving the clipping issue you experienced! 🎉

## ✅ **Fixed Header with Scrollable Body Implementation**

### **Key Changes Made:**

## ✅ **Fixed Table Alignment Issue**

### **Problem Solved:**

The issue was that I had created **two separate tables** (one for header, one for body), which caused:
- ❌ **Column misalignment** between header and body

```jsx
{/* Single Table with Sticky Header */}

    <thead className="sticky top-0 z-20">
      {/* Header content */}
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      {/* Body content */}
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
```

- ✅ **Scrollable Body**: Only the table body scrolls with `max-h-96 overflow-y-auto`
- ✅ **Single Table Structure**: Maintains proper table semantics and alignment
- ✅ **Consistent Widths**: All columns have matching widths between header and body

### **Benefits:**

1. **Perfect Alignment**: Header and body columns are perfectly aligned
2. **Better Performance**: Single table is more efficient than two separate tables
3. **Proper Semantics**: Maintains correct HTML table structure
4. **Responsive Design**: Works consistently across all screen sizes
5. **Accessibility**: Better for screen readers and keyboard navigation

### **Result:**

Now the DataTable component provides:
- ✅ **Fixed header** that stays visible while scrolling
- ✅ **Scrollable body** with proper height limit
- ✅ **Perfect column alignment** between header and body
- ✅ **Consistent visual appearance** across all pages

The table headers and data are now perfectly aligned while maintaining the fixed header functionality! 🎉

## ✅ **Select All Functionality Implemented:**

### **Features Added:**

1. **State Management:**
   - `selectedTeachers` - Set to track selected teacher IDs
   - `isAllSelected` - Boolean to check if all teachers are selected
   - `isIndeterminate` - Boolean for partial selection state

2. **Event Handlers:**
   - `handleSelectAll(checked)` - Handles header checkbox click
   - `handleSelectTeacher(teacherId, checked)` - Handles individual row checkbox clicks

3. **Header Checkbox:**
   - ✅ **Select All** - Clicking selects/deselects all teachers
   - ✅ **Indeterminate State** - Shows partial selection when some (but not all) are selected
   - ✅ **Visual Feedback** - Proper checked/unchecked states

4. **Individual Checkboxes:**
   - ✅ **Individual Selection** - Each row can be selected independently
   - ✅ **State Synchronization** - Individual checkboxes reflect current selection state
   - ✅ **Proper Styling** - Consistent with design system

5. **Visual Indicators:**
   - ✅ **Selection Counter** - Shows "X selected" when items are selected
   - ✅ **Dynamic Display** - Counter appears/disappears based on selection

### **How It Works:**

1. **Click Header Checkbox:**
   - If unchecked → Selects all teachers
   - If checked → Deselects all teachers
   - If indeterminate → Selects all teachers

2. **Click Individual Checkbox:**
   - Toggles that specific teacher's selection
   - Updates header checkbox state automatically

3. **Visual Feedback:**
   - Header checkbox shows checked/unchecked/indeterminate states
   - Selection counter shows how many items are selected
   - Individual checkboxes reflect their selection state

### **Result:**

The checkbox functionality now works exactly like modern data tables:
- ✅ **Select All** - Header checkbox selects/deselects all rows
- ✅ **Individual Selection** - Each row can be selected independently  
- ✅ **Visual Feedback** - Clear indication of selection state
- ✅ **Selection Counter** - Shows number of selected items
- ✅ **Proper States** - Handles checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states

The implementation is ready for future bulk operations like bulk delete, bulk export, or bulk status updates! 🎉

Perfect! I've fixed the issue. The problem was that the `columns` useMemo had an empty dependency array `[]`, which meant it wasn't re-rendering when the `selectedTeachers` state changed. 

## ✅ **Issue Fixed:**

### **Problem:**
The `columns` useMemo had an empty dependency array `[]`, which prevented the individual checkboxes from updating when the `selectedTeachers` state changed.

### **Solution:**
Updated the dependency array to include the necessary dependencies:
```javascript
], [selectedTeachers, handleSelectTeacher]);
```

### **How It Works Now:**

1. **Header Checkbox Click:**
   - Calls `handleSelectAll(checked)`
   - Updates `selectedTeachers` state
   - Triggers re-render of `columns` due to dependency array
   - All individual checkboxes update to reflect the new state

2. **Individual Checkbox Click:**
   - Calls `handleSelectTeacher(teacherId, checked)`
   - Updates `selectedTeachers` state
   - Triggers re-render of `columns` due to dependency array
   - Header checkbox updates to reflect the new state (checked/unchecked/indeterminate)

### **Result:**

Now when you click the top checkbox:
- ✅ **All individual checkboxes will be checked** when you select all
- ✅ **All individual checkboxes will be unchecked** when you deselect all
- ✅ **Header checkbox shows proper state** (checked/unchecked/indeterminate)
- ✅ **Selection counter updates** to show the number of selected items
- ✅ **Individual checkboxes work independently** and update the header state

The checkbox functionality should now work perfectly! When you click the top checkbox, all the other checkboxes will be checked and selected. 🎉

## Key Changes Made:

### 1. **Import DataTable Component**
- Added `import { DataTable } from '../components/ui';` to both files

### 2. **Replaced Custom Table with DataTable**
- Removed the entire custom table implementation (thead, tbody, pagination controls, etc.)
- Replaced with the modern `DataTable` component that has built-in fixed header functionality

- **S.No. Column**: Displays sequential numbering with proper indexing
- **Roll No Column**: Shows student roll numbers with medium font weight
- **Student Name Column**: Displays student names

- **Pagination Configuration**: Includes entries per page selector and pagination controls

- ✅ **Search functionality**: Now integrated into the DataTable component
- ✅ **Pagination**: Now handled by the DataTable component

### 6. **Fixed Header Implementation**
The DataTable component now provides:
- ✅ **Sticky header**: `sticky top-0 z-20` on the thead
- ✅ **Scrollable body**: `max-h-96 overflow-y-auto` on the container
- ✅ **Proper z-index**: `z-20` for the header
- ✅ **Shadow separation**: `shadow-sm` for visual separation

Both pages now have the same modern, consistent table experience as the `Courses.jsx` page, with fixed headers that remain visible while scrolling through student data. The tables will automatically handle large datasets with smooth scrolling and maintain the header visibility at all times.
